# Compatibility Checklist: Mod foundation

**Purpose**: Test the quality of R1's requirements for loading, load order, requirements on other mods, error-free
loading against baselines, saves and community-content presentation
**Created**: 2026-11-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is Imperium's place relative to the ordinary mods after the official expansions specified, and not only
  its place after them? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK002 Does the spec state whether Imperium requires the Harmony mod and whether it needs a load-order entry for
  it, each with its source? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for what the game reports about a mod that loads no content, given that R1 adds
  none? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, §FR-007]
- [x] CHK004 Is it specified where players are told Imperium's place in the mod list? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011,
  §SC-005]
- [x] CHK005 Is the outcome specified for a save made with Imperium and loaded with it turned off, and the reverse?
  [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, §Clarifications]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is "ordinary mod" defined so that FR-011 does not conflict with the Harmony mod, which loads before Core?
  [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK007 Is "no errors or warnings from Imperium" defined by a measurable rule, with the log it reads and the
  baseline it compares with? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications, §SC-001]
- [x] CHK008 Is "directly after the last active official expansion" unambiguous when some expansions are off?
  [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK009 Is "presented as community-created content" stated in observable terms (maker, place among the official
  expansions)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, §SC-004]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Do FR-005 and FR-006 ("no errors from Imperium") agree with FR-007 ("no game content")? [Conflict, Spec
  §FR-005, §FR-007]
- [x] CHK011 Do SC-001, SC-003 and SC-005 count the same kinds of log lines that FR-005 rules out (errors and
  warnings)? [Consistency, Spec §SC-001, §SC-003, §SC-005, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK012 Does the load-order fallback the plan allows (`loadAfter` for `forceLoadAfter`) still meet FR-011's
  rule that only Ludeon's packages are named? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK013 Is the presentation in FR-008 and FR-009 consistent with the assumption that R1 has no description or
  preview images? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, §FR-009, §Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK014 Does each success criterion name its baseline in the same terms (the same launch without Imperium)?
  [Measurability, Spec §Clarifications, §SC-001, §SC-003, §SC-005]
- [x] CHK015 Can SC-002's "100% of attempts" be measured, given that the game's requirement check does not vary
  between attempts? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK016 Does SC-005 make the place players are told checkable, not only the place the game accepts?
  [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Are requirements defined for turning Imperium on while ordinary mods are already active?
  [Coverage, Spec §FR-011, §US3]
- [x] CHK018 Is the case of another mod that builds on Imperium and must load after it covered? [Coverage, Spec §Edge
  Cases]
- [x] CHK019 Is Imperium placed above an official expansion covered for both outcomes the game may give, a refused
  move or a warning? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK020 Are a game version other than 1.7, two installed copies and expansions installed but off all covered?
  [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §SC-003]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK021 Is the log's location an assumption the spec leaves to the plan, consistently with the testing sources?
  [Assumption, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK022 Is it stated which later entry adds the Harmony requirement and how it is triggered? [Dependency, Spec
  §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
- Reviewed 2026-11-24 by the R1 thread, at the coordinating session's request; none of the items is game content, so
  none went to the maintainer (constitution, Principle IV). CHK003, CHK010 and CHK011 failed as first written and
  passed after the spec changes recorded in [requirements.md](requirements.md), fifth review: FR-005 expects the
  game's one report that Imperium loaded no content, and SC-001, SC-003 and SC-005 count errors and warnings alike.
  The other items passed as written.
